reason: No written rule or enforcement action makes me govern customers' agents today. Our terms already put agent risk on the customer and my engineers rate-limit every API key, so I'm not putting a pre-SOC 2 startup in the path of every trade before a regulator tells me to.
objection: A startup with no customers and no SOC 2 sitting inline as a proxy on our order and payment flow is a new single point of failure and a vendor-risk headache. 'Evidence under FINRA and MAS SAFR headings' is a nice label, but no examiner has asked me for it.
would_change_my_mind: A final rule, or an enforcement action against a peer venue, that explicitly holds the venue responsible for controlling customer AI agents' trades.
